title: boehmeria repens
intro: Boehmeria repens, commonly known as False nettle or Roving Jenny, is a species of flowering plant in the nettle family Urticaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, lowering blood pressure, and aiding in the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Boehmeria repens include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Boehmeria repens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
